name: stealth_phoenix_4dir
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production 16-bit Overdrive game-animation sheet based on the exact armored helmeted character in the reference, not a redesign. ONE transparent sheet with EXACTLY 6 equal COLUMNS and 8 equal ROWS =48 isolated sprites, preferably 1536x2048. Each ROW is a SIX-frame motion strip ordered left to right. Equal cell centers, same actor scale across the ENTIRE sheet, generous gutters, weapon tips never cross cells. Top-down 3/4 overhead camera fixed. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, tight palette, black outlines, metallic tiny highlights. Preserve costume, helmet, visor, body build, gun and colors. No exposed face/hair, no labels/text/grid/scenery or ground shadows. No blue movement trails or colored backplates.
Rows 1-4 are in-place CROUCH-WALK loops, holding the compact rifle forward with both hands. Knees stay deeply bent, hips and head lower than standing, feet take short alternating stealth steps. Six distinct gait phases with smooth last-to-first wrap; no standing upright.
ROW1 crouch-walk NORTH/up: helmet back and backpack facing viewer, rifle up, no visor facing viewer.
ROW2 crouch-walk EAST/right.
ROW3 crouch-walk SOUTH/down: visor toward viewer, rifle down.
ROW4 crouch-walk WEST/left: visibly left-facing, properly redrawn from this view, not a rotated overhead decal.
Rows5-8 are STATIONARY PRONE AIM/FIRE six-frame cycles: whole body belly-down, elbows braced, chest and pelvis touching ground, legs stretched behind. 1 aim, 2 small muzzle flash/recoil, 3 settle, 4 small muzzle flash/recoil, 5 settle, 6 ready. Body root, head and gun scale stay fixed. Feet do not walk or crawl. Small flash stays at barrel tip.
ROW5 prone fire NORTH: head at TOP, extended legs/boots at BOTTOM, rifle protrudes above helmet toward TOP. Back of helmet visible, no front visor. Long body laid along vertical screen axis, not kneeling/standing.
ROW6 prone fire EAST: head RIGHT, boots LEFT, barrel points RIGHT.
ROW7 prone fire SOUTH: head BOTTOM, boots TOP, rifle toward BOTTOM, visor visible.
ROW8 prone fire WEST: head LEFT, boots RIGHT, rifle toward LEFT.
Entire figures fully visible, comfortable transparent cell margins. Match the reference and keep one fixed camera and one consistent proportion set throughout. Actor is PHOENIX, exact black/charcoal armor with ember-red plates and golden visor and trims; same sturdy build, phoenix shoulder emblem as reference, fully helmeted.

name: enemy_scout_patrol
prompt: Create a production pixel-art animation sheet extending the provided existing Bullets of Fury Overdrive enemy reference, exact same 16-bit pixel clustering, metallic black outlines and vivid magenta symbiote infection. Constant fixed top-down 3/4 camera, same body and weapon scale throughout, generous gutters, no labels, grid, scenery, ground shadows, trails, duplicate ghosts or motion smears. Each row a sequential SIX frame strip left to right. ROW1 north/up in-place patrol walk loop, back of helmet to viewer, rifle upward. ROW2 east/right patrol walk. ROW5 stationary EAST aim and shoot cycle: aim, muzzle flash, recoil settle, muzzle flash, settle, aim; tiny flashes at barrel, body root stable. Tall slim predatory robotic limbs, distinctive triangular shoulder armor. Ignore all other reference rows. Every cell is the SAME scout.
